export const claimKey = record => digest([record.repository, record.component || "general",
  [...record.paths].sort(), normalizedClaim(record.text)]);

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Knowledge retrieval groups a lesson with its Markdown mirror, historical summary, original lesson and portable copy. Claim identity includes repository, component and paths. A copied summary does not become a second independent source. Keep different text and component scopes separate. The focused conflict-and-scope test passed; this does not resolve conflicting interpretations.
title: Group copied knowledge without collapsing different component scopes
